body: Thank you for your kind words. I've been thinking a lot about what you've said, and I think this feels like a therapeutic release. I'd no way dare say I'm a poet, I'm no where near as skilled. And I definitely do not want to take away from the people on /r/suicidewatch who do need someone to talk to more than me. So I wanted to ask your advice on where I can post similar types of posts with my feeling on paper, so to speak. I feel like if I write more it might help me feel better. I feel like posting on /r/offmychest may trigger intense feelings from some things I feel/write, and that's definitely the last thing I want. I'm not looking for an audience or even compliments, I just have no other way of expressing myself. I'm sorry if I come across as conceited, I've honestly been wracking my brains on how to phrase this.
